page.overview:
Who is Hydra?

The Hydra is a fictional entity whose origins lie within Classical Greek mythology. It has been mentioned in a number of Cthulhu Mythos stories, as well as in other related works through its real-world aspect.

The Hydra is a creature that lurks in the deepest parts of the Mesopotamian Sea. It takes the form of a many headed serpent that harbours a bitter hatred for surface dwellers, spitting acid and poisonous venom at unsuspecting travellers.(source?)

The Lernean Hydra was a descendant of the Elder God Set, sired by Set's granddaughter and mother of many prominent mythological monstrous figures Echidna, who mated with the Titan Typhon.

The Hydra was multi-headed reptilian monster who could grow two heads when one was removed, and whose blood was venomous. The Hydra became stuff of legends in Greece, and was one of the "labours" assigned to the demigod Hercules.
